title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 91
paragraphs: Meanwhile, as the barbarians turned to flight and were sailing out toward Phaleron, the Aeginetans waited for them in the strait and performed memorable deeds. While the Athenians, in the confused tumult, were disabling both the ships that resisted and those that were fleeing, the Aeginetans were destroying those that attempted to sail away; and whenever any escaped the Athenians, they ran at full course into the Aeginetans.
